description_en: Modifies the name, description, cross-region bandwidth, and DSCP value configurations of a queue in a traffic QoS policy
description_zh: 调用UpdateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueueAttribute接口修改流量调度策略下队列的名称、描述、跨地域带宽、DSCP值的配置
name: UpdateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueueAttribute

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can generate the token value on the client side. Ensure that the token is unique across different requests and does not exceed 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run. The system checks the request for required parameters, request format, and service limits, but does not modify the queue configuration. If the request fails the check, an error is returned. If the request passes the check, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a standard request. If the request passes the check, the queue configuration is modified
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会修改队列的配置。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接修改队列的配置
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The new name of the queue. The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
队列的新名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: qos_queue_name

parameters.help_en: The new description of the queue. The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
队列新的描述信息。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: qos_queue_description

parameters.help_en: The percentage of the cross-region bandwidth that can be used by the current queue when bandwidth is allocated by percentage. Enter a number without the percent sign (%)
parameters.help_zh:
按带宽百分比模式分配时，当前队列可使用的跨地域带宽的百分比。

输入数字即可，无需输入百分号（%）
parameters.name: remain_bandwidth_percent

parameters.help_en: The absolute value of the cross-region bandwidth that can be used by the current queue when bandwidth is allocated by absolute value. Unit: Mbit/s. Enter a number without the unit
parameters.help_zh:
按带宽绝对值模式分配时，当前队列可使用的跨地域带宽的绝对值，单位Mbps。

输入数字即可，无需输入单位
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en: The DSCP values of the traffic packets to be matched by the current queue
parameters.help_zh: 当前队列待匹配的流量报文的DSCP值
parameters.name: dscps
